propositions: Removal records for managed-but-never-peer-confirmed links must be declined and logged to prevent deletion of links the peer never carried.

Managed refs marked strictly monotonic locally cannot distinguish never-pushed local links from peer-deleted ones; outbound dedup on (vendor_type, target_key) direction-agnostically leaves relation-scoped collisions unprotected.

A persistent peer-confirmation record keyed by (source_local_id, target_local_id, relation) with Jira linkId and confirming snapshot revision must be written on successful outbound link ADD and loaded from authoritative snapshots.
Removal records for peer-confirmed links must still converge with relation-scoped precision as established in e39f.

Completeness of peer snapshots is a trichotomy: absent issuelinks key means unobserved, empty list means authoritatively empty, populated means evidence; partial/paginated/failed reads must never confirm or deny.
